name: Line Graph (Skill)
description: A smooth line draws itself while one big number counts up with its tip and lands on the final value. Hermes renders it with /graph.

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
Never invent data: a shot without numbers in the storyboard gets no graph values; say the curve is illustrative or leave the number out.
One number, one line: no callouts, growth chips or marketing words.
The label is a plain noun, not a slogan.

curation.notes: Evidence for trial of a hermes pack (there is no Hermes in CI, so no CI render exists or is claimed). The skill is in the source repository at the pinned commit and the owner reports it works in Hermes. Every portal run of this pack is a research trial, never published.

hermes.input: The run's skill brief gives one shot per clip, in order, each with its seconds and the skill's JSON spec (brief.shots[i].spec), written by Hermes from the approved script and the research notes following the skill's spec and taste rules (label, values (2 or more, oldest first), labels, final, prefix, suffix, decimals, dark); never invent data the script and notes do not give. Render each spec with the skill, fit each clip to the shot's seconds (hold the last frame when the shot is longer, play it faster when shorter), cut them together, add the run's narration as the audio and burn the run's captions in the caption band. No pictures are made for this workflow.
hermes.output: One 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 at 30 fps with the narration, published under /clip/ on the media host. The studio then runs qc-video and the owner scores it on Review.
